text:
Maia: Quick sync — planning to push release-sprint-12 across three zones today. Window 16:00-18:00 UTC. Need owners for NA/EU/APAC and smoke pairing. Can each zone confirm?

Devin: I'll take NA (16:00-16:40). PR #5123 merged, but still waiting a perf smoke in staging. @Lucy can you do NA smoke?

Lucy: Happy to. I'll run the smoke checklist and post results. Expect ~15m.

Sanjay: I'll take EU (16:40-17:20). FYI EU has a short migration TTL change — keep rollback ready. Queued a canary on two hosts now.

Tom: APAC for me (17:20-18:00). Need ops to confirm regional routing policy is set to prefer local endpoints. I'll hold CDN invalidation until after smoke.

deploy-bot: Canary started for NA at 16:05 UTC — 2/2 healthy. Auto-scaler OK.

Devin: NA smoke green. Minor log churn but not user-impacting. Rolling main traffic now.

Maia: Good. Reminder: feature flag is roll-forward-only for this sprint. If any error rate >5% or latency spike >200ms, rollback immediately. Rollback plan: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-sprint12

Lucy: Confirmed — I'll attach smoke artifacts (curl output, minimal logs) to this thread after each zone.

Sanjay: EU canary shows DB connections +12%. I bumped app pool by +10% in canary; will observe for 5m. @db-monitor please keep an eye on RDS connection count.

db-monitor: Active alert tracking connection count; suppressing noisy alerts for canary window. Threshold remains +20%.

Tom: APAC ready — one note: CDN invalidation queued at T+10m after roll. Adding that to the post-roll checklist.

Maia: Timeline locked: NA -> EU -> APAC. Ping here when each smoke finishes and attach artifacts. :thumbsup:

Devin: NA done, artifacts posted to #eng-sre and linked in thread. Moving off the slot.

Lucy: Received. All good from NA.

Sanjay: EU looks stable at +3% connections now, proceeding to shift traffic.

Tom: Starting APAC canary now. Will report in ~12m.

Maia: Thanks all — I'll update the release board and mark the sprint as deployed if APAC finishes clean.
